name: Whirlpool Jazz FD Cabinet Thermistor
purpose: W10322959 Jazz — 10,000 Ω @ 77°F; 29,500 Ω @ 36°F; 86,300 Ω @ 0°F. Service tests 4 (FF) and 5 (FZ) show P/O/S.
failureModes: Open — service test 4 or 5 shows O
In range but warm cabinet — damper (test 6) or sealed system
testingTips: Enter Service Test Mode: door switch held + Fridge UP ×3 → S-E
Run test 4 FF or test 5 FZ — P=pass, O=open, S=short
Measure at control harness with power disconnected for bench ohms

name: Whirlpool Jazz FD Defrost Heater
purpose: 19 cu 33 Ω / 22 cu 30 Ω / 20–25 cu 28 Ω @ 115 VAC (395–470 W). Service test 1 energizes heater.
failureModes: Open — no defrost; heavy evap frost
Good ohms but no heat in test 1 — control board relay
testingTips: Service test 1: defrost thermostat O=open, S=closed while heater on
Adaptive defrost: 15 min optimum; 25 min max if bimetal stuck closed

name: Whirlpool Jazz FD Defrost Thermostat (Bimetal)
purpose: Closes above 42°F ±5°; opens below 12°F ±7°. Service test 1 shows O (open) or S (closed).
failureModes: Open when frosted — no defrost heat path
Stuck closed — extended defrost; 25 min board timeout resets interval to 8 hr
testingTips: Must be closed (few Ω) when evaporator is frosted/cold
Opens when warm after successful defrost

name: Whirlpool Jazz FD Compressor Run Winding (EM2Y60)
purpose: Embraco EM2Y60 run winding 4.75 Ω ±8%. Service test 2 toggles compressor/condenser fan.
failureModes: Open winding — compressor silent; relay clicks
Run OK but no start — check start winding and relay/capacitor
testingTips: Service test 2: freezer 2, fridge O=compressor on

name: Whirlpool Jazz FD Compressor Start Winding (EM2Y60)
purpose: Start winding 6.1 Ω ±8% @ 77°F. Run cap 12 µfd ±10%.
failureModes: Relay TSD2/5sP or 12 µfd cap failure with good windings
testingTips: Full load 1.60 A; LRA 10.8 A per spec table
Test relay and 12 µfd cap before condemning compressor
